intro.h2: A Greenville Contractor for Bathrooms and Tile
paragraphs: Watson Construction handles bathroom remodeling in Greenville from its base at 700 Sewanee St. Its Facebook page says the company has over 20 years of experience, and its online listing tags tiling and carpentry as core trades.

That mix matters in a bathroom, where the floor, the walls and the trim all have to come together. Watson also lists countertops and flooring among its services, so a bath or kitchen update can start with one phone call. The company's Facebook information notes free estimates, so you can find out what the job involves first. Call (662) 703-1991 or email onewatsonconstruction@gmail.com to talk about your project.
